tasks.title: Extend Human Type with Health and Mood
tasks.description: Add health and mood fields to the Human interface in shared/types.ts to support the new needs system mechanics.
tasks.details: Update the Human type in shared/types.ts to include two new fields: health (number, 0-100) and mood (number, 0-100). Ensure the type is properly exported and compatible with existing code.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify TypeScript compilation succeeds and that objects of type Human can be created with health and mood fields.

tasks.title: Update Human Generator with Initial Health and Mood
tasks.description: Modify humanGenerator.ts to initialize new humans with appropriate health and mood values.
tasks.details: In server/humanGenerator.ts, add health: randInt(70, 100) and mood: randInt(60, 100) to the human generation logic.
tasks.testStrategy: Generate multiple humans and verify health is 70-100 and mood is 60-100.

tasks.title: Implement Eating Mechanics with Food Consumption
tasks.description: Update simulationEngine.ts so that 'eating' action actually consumes city food and restores hunger.
tasks.details: In the human update loop: when currentAction === 'eating', find the human's city, if city.food >= 1 then city.food -= 1 and human.hunger += random(50, 70), clamp to 100. Update eating threshold from hunger < 20 to hunger < 25.
tasks.testStrategy: Human with eating action + food: hunger increases, food decreases. No food: hunger stays same.

tasks.title: Implement Resting Mechanics with Energy Recovery
tasks.description: Update simulationEngine.ts so that 'resting' action restores energy and prevents movement.
tasks.details: When currentAction === 'resting': human.energy += random(15, 25), clamp to 100. Ensure movement chance is skipped for resting humans.
tasks.testStrategy: Resting human recovers energy and does not change position.

tasks.title: Implement Health System with Death Mechanics
tasks.description: Create health update logic that depends on hunger/energy and handles death when health reaches 0.
tasks.details: In server/simulationEngine.ts, after updating hunger and energy: health update rules based on hunger/energy, death handling when health <= 0, death chance when health < 3 AND mood < 5.
tasks.testStrategy: Health decreases when hunger/energy = 0, increases when both > 50. Human removed at health = 0.

subtasks.title: Implement health update rules based on hunger and energy
subtasks.description: Add logic to update human health: hunger=0 → health-=5-10, energy=0 → health-=3-7, both>50 → health+=2-5, clamp 0-100.
subtasks.details: In server/simulationEngine.ts, after updating hunger and energy: if hunger === 0: health -= random(5, 10); if energy === 0: health -= random(3, 7); if hunger > 50 && energy > 50: health += random(2, 5); clamp health to 0-100.
subtasks.testStrategy: Health decreases when hunger/energy=0, increases when both>50, clamped at 0-100.

subtasks.title: Implement death handling when health reaches 0
subtasks.description: Remove human from world.humans and city.humanIds, log death event.
subtasks.details: If health <= 0: remove from world.humans, remove humanId from city.humanIds, add eventLog entry: '{name} умер от истощения'.
subtasks.testStrategy: Human at health=0 is removed from all data structures. Death event is logged.

subtasks.title: Implement death chance mechanic for critically low stats
subtasks.description: 30% death chance when health < 3 AND mood < 5.
subtasks.details: After health update: if health < 3 AND mood < 5, apply 30% death chance (DEATH_CHANCE = 0.3). Same removal logic as health <= 0.
subtasks.testStrategy: Human with health<3 and mood<5 has 30% death chance. No death chance otherwise.

tasks.title: Implement Mood System
tasks.description: Create mood update logic based on overall wellbeing of the human.
tasks.details: In server/simulationEngine.ts, after health update: mood += 5-10 if all stats > 70, mood -= 5-10 if any stat < 30, clamp 0-100.
tasks.testStrategy: Mood increases when all stats > 70, decreases when any < 30, clamped at 0-100.

subtasks.title: Implement mood update rules based on hunger, energy, and health
subtasks.description: All stats > 70 → mood += 5-10. Any stat < 30 → mood -= 5-10. Clamp 0-100.
subtasks.details: In server/simulationEngine.ts, after health update: if hunger > 70 && energy > 70 && health > 70: mood += random(5, 10); if hunger < 30 || energy < 30 || health < 30: mood -= random(5, 10); clamp mood to 0-100.
subtasks.testStrategy: Mood goes up when all > 70, down when any < 30, stays neutral otherwise.

tasks.title: Implement Population Dynamics
tasks.description: Add birth mechanics and city destruction based on average morale and food availability.
tasks.details: In updateCityForNewDay: calculate average mood, birth if mood>70 and food>pop*2 with 2% chance, city becomes ruins when last human dies.
tasks.testStrategy: High mood + food → birth chance. Last human dies → ruins.

subtasks.title: Calculate average mood of city residents
subtasks.description: Iterate city.humanIds, fetch each human from world.humans, compute average mood.
subtasks.details: In updateCityForNewDay: sum mood values of all residents via city.humanIds, divide by count. Handle empty city (return 0).
subtasks.testStrategy: Correct average for multiple humans, single human, empty city.

subtasks.title: Implement birth condition checks and probability
subtasks.description: If average mood > 70 AND city.food > population * 2, apply 2% birth chance.
subtasks.details: Check averageMood > 70 AND city.food > (city.humanIds.length * 2). If true, Math.random() < POPULATION_GROWTH_RATE triggers birth.
subtasks.testStrategy: Conditions pass with high mood+food, fail otherwise. 2% probability works.

subtasks.title: Generate new human and log birth event
subtasks.description: Call generateHumansForCity on successful birth, add to world.humans and city.humanIds, log event.
subtasks.details: On successful birth: generate human via generateHumansForCity, add to world.humans[human.id] and city.humanIds.push(human.id). Log: 'Новый житель родился в {city.name}'.
subtasks.testStrategy: New human appears in world.humans and city.humanIds. Birth event logged.

subtasks.title: Implement city destruction when last human dies
subtasks.description: When city.humanIds becomes empty after a death, mark city as ruins and log destruction event.
subtasks.details: In death handling (Task 5 logic): after removing human from city.humanIds, if length === 0, set city status to 'ruins' and log '{city.name} превратился в руины'.
subtasks.testStrategy: City with 1 human dying becomes ruins. City with >1 human stays active.

subtasks.title: Integrate population dynamics into updateCityForNewDay
subtasks.description: Combine mood calculation, birth, and city destruction into the city update function in correct order.
subtasks.details: In updateCityForNewDay: after food/gold updates, calculate average mood → check birth conditions → attempt birth → log events → check for city destruction.
subtasks.testStrategy: Full simulation: births happen in thriving cities, ruins form when last human dies.

tasks.title: Add Health and Mood Progress Bars to Inspector UI
tasks.description: Extend Inspector component to display health and mood progress bars with appropriate colors.
tasks.details: In Inspector.tsx and Inspector.module.css: add health bar (red→green, label 'Здоровье') and mood bar (gray→gold, label 'Настроение'). All 4 bars: hunger, energy, health, mood.
tasks.testStrategy: 4 bars displayed with correct colors and Russian labels.

tasks.title: Update Human Dot Colors Based on Health
tasks.description: Modify MapRenderer to color human dots based on their health status.
tasks.details: Replace HUMAN_DOT_COLOR with getHumanDotColor(health): >60 → blue #3b82f6, 30-60 → yellow #eab308, <30 → red #ef4444.
tasks.testStrategy: Dot colors match health: blue (>60), yellow (30-60), red (<30).

tasks.title: Verify WebSocket Protocol for Health and Mood Data
tasks.description: Ensure server sends complete human data including health and mood to clients via WebSocket.
tasks.details: Verify worldState payload includes humans with all fields. Check ServerMessage type in worldSocket.ts. Ensure no data is filtered out.
tasks.testStrategy: Client receives health and mood via WebSocket. Values update in real-time.
